title: Benefits Report
description: Participation, plan mix, employer cost and open enrollment.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers Benefits. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: Participation, plan mix, employer cost and open enrollment.

Plan mix drives cost: PPO costs most, HDHP least.

**Ask:** is participation high enough to keep the plan affordable?
Employer vs employee cost by plan type and medical coverage tiers.
**Employer vs Employee Cost by Plan Type**

The employer pays most of medical; vision is fully employee-paid.

Family coverage is the most expensive tier.

**Ask:** is the contribution strategy competitive?
**Employer vs Employee Cost by Plan Type**

Low participation can mean low pay relative to premiums.

**Ask:** which locations need open enrollment support?
